Use `snl macro usages` to find every structured use of a Macro before rename, update, or deletion.

### Agent procedure
1. Supply the exact Macro ID and inspect all returned usage classes.
2. Distinguish semantic Macro calls from local variables or literal text; use the result as the destructive-action gate.

### Machine-use contract
Invoke `snl macro usages` with an explicit `--root` and `--json`. Treat returned IDs and revisions as opaque. Branch on the structured status and exit code; do not scrape human-formatted output or edit `.SNL_Doc` files directly.
